rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for the hair on a person's head.

example.english: I want to cut my hair shorter.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zin2 dyun2 di1 tau4 faat3

rows.note: Use 毛 for body hair or an animal's coat rather than the hair on the human head.

example.english: This dog is covered in hair.
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gau2 seng4 san1 dou1 hai6 mou4

rows.note: Use this for one individual strand of hair from the head.

example.english: I see a strand of hair on your shirt.
example.traditional: 我喺你件衫上面見到一條頭髮。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 nei5 gin6 saam1 soeng6 min6 gin3 dou2 jat1 tiu4 tau4 faat3

rows.note: Use this for a tiny amount, degree, or distance when English uses hair to mean just a little.

example.english: Move forward just a hair and we’ll fall into the sea.
example.traditional: 再行前一丁點就跌落海喇。
example.jyutping: zoi3 haang4 cin4 jat1 ding1 dim2 zau6 dit3 lok6 hoi2 laa3
